businesses.business: Calibration services and test equipment distribution

offering_description.value: Transcat provides accredited calibration, compliance and asset management services to laboratories and industrial operators. It works on-site and through its calibration labs, repairs test equipment, and sells, rents and leases new and used instruments.

quotes.quote: At Transcat, we help the world’s most critical industries stay accurate, compliant, and competitive. As a trusted provider of calibration services, compliance solutions, and test and measurement equipment distribution and rentals, we bring precision and reliability to every customer interaction — from the lab floor to the production line.

Transcat is an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited provider offering calibration of electrical, mechanical, temperature, pressure, and dimensional instruments. Whether in-lab or onsite, we deliver compliant, auditable results with fast turnaround times.

quotes.quote: Transcat is a global leader in SO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration & dimensional inspection services in the United States. Buy or rent quality test equipment and calibration tools that comply with safety standards. Free shipping available!

Transcat is a top distributor of electronic test and measurement equipment from trusted global brands. We offer new and used equipment, rentals, and leasing options to meet your needs and your budget.
